oneOf.description: Attack a visible enemy entity with one of your units.

thoughtProcess.description: Brief strategic reasoning behind this decision. At most 2 sentences and under 50 words (max 500 characters).

attackerId.description: ID of your owned unit performing the attack.

targetId.description: ID of the specific visible enemy entity to attack.

command.description: This response performs the ATTACK command.

oneOf.description: Repair a damaged entity with one of your units.

thoughtProcess.description: Brief strategic reasoning behind this decision. At most 2 sentences and under 50 words (max 500 characters).

repairerId.description: ID of your owned unit performing the repair.

targetId.description: ID of the specific damaged entity to repair (yours or an ally's).

command.description: This response performs the REPAIR command.

oneOf.description: Build a new entity with one of your builders.

thoughtProcess.description: Brief strategic reasoning behind this decision. At most 2 sentences and under 50 words (max 500 characters).

builderId.description: ID of your owned builder (settler, worker, village, etc.).

entityName.description: Type name of the entity to build (must be in the builder's Builds list).

command.description: This response performs the BUILD command.

oneOf.description: Explore with one of your units.

thoughtProcess.description: Brief strategic reasoning behind this decision. At most 2 sentences and under 50 words (max 500 characters).

explorerId.description: ID of your owned unit exploring.

direction.description: Direction to explore in; omit to explore toward the closest unexplored area.

command.description: This response performs the EXPLORE command.

oneOf.description: Initiate diplomacy with an opponent (costs 1 order).

thoughtProcess.description: Brief strategic reasoning behind this decision. At most 2 sentences and under 50 words (max 500 characters).

targetPlayerId.description: ID of opponent player to open chat with.

message.description: Optional opening message or proposition to send.

command.description: This response performs the CHAT command.

oneOf.description: End your turn. The only response that carries a note.

thoughtProcess.description: Brief strategic reasoning behind this decision. At most 2 sentences and under 50 words (max 500 characters).

note.description: Strategic reminder to yourself for your next turn.

command.description: This response performs the END_TURN command.
